target_text: // With TRON_K_VNNI the 128-dimension slot has no row view (Note [K VNNI storage]).
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

"goes through the layout-agnostic accessors" restates the set_k_row call under it. The placement reason, why this slot is written differently from its 64- and 256-dimension neighbours, is the missing row view, and that fits one line.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // With TRON_K_VNNI the 128-dimension slot has no row view (Note [K VNNI storage]).
```
